channel.title: CNN 5 Things
channel.description: Monday through Friday get up to speed on the biggest headlines of the day with 5 Things. On Saturdays, get a break for your ears with good news from 5 Good Things. And at noon and Sundays, we take you beyond the headlines to help make sense of what everyone is talking about in politics and beyond with One Thing.

item.title: Trump Returns to China
item.description: Chinese leader Xi Jinping gives President Donald Trump an unprecedented airport greeting ahead of an annual regional economic summit. Iran is expanding its attacks across the Gulf region following a US strike inside Iran. Parts of coastal Florida are bracing for more rain after days of persistent downpours and flooding. The White House dropped Trump’s latest pick to lead the Food and Drug Administration. Plus, Cambridge Dictionary has announced its word of the year. Learn more about your ad choices. item.title: Trump’s Asia Tour Begins
item.description: President Donald Trump kicks off his Asia trip in the Philippines, signing trade papers with Thailand that stops short of a full deal. Meanwhile, Trump warns Iran would pay a major price if it carried out an attack on the nation’s capital. Several people are injured after severe turbulence on a flight headed to Florida. Massive attacks between Russia and Ukraine have damaged major bridges. Plus, Pizza Hut’s last surviving co-founder has died. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

item.title: Trump: FAA Equipment ‘Had a Heart Attack’
item.description: President Donald Trump weighs in on the nationwide ground stop that paralyzed air travel over the weekend – and the funding fight that lies ahead. Lindsay Clancy will be tried again for the murder of her children next year. New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani says a controversial NYPD unit is being disbanded.
